state.case_summary:
An HIV-negative man presented with a 12-month history of left-sided nasal congestion and obstruction despite medical treatment.

Physical examination revealed a large polypoid mass obstructing the left nasal cavity.

- Imaging Studies:    1. Computed Tomographic Imaging:       Image Title: Computed Tomographic Images Demonstrating Soft Tissue Mass       Image Description: Soft tissue polypoid density not involving the orbit or skull base, obstructing the left nasal cavity        2. Pathological Analysis:       - CD138-positive       - CD56-positive       - CD20-negative       - PAX5-negative       - EBV-positive       - Fluorescence in situ hybridization showed gains of florescence signal at multiple loci:         * 3q27 (BCL6)         * 8q24 (MYC)         * 14q32 (IGH)        3. Additional Studies:       - MRI       - PET scan       - Bone marrow biopsy       (All showed no local or distant metastatic disease)

root.label: Chronic Progressive Unilateral Nasal Obstruction with Soft Tissue Mass
supporting_facts: 12-month history of left-sided nasal congestion and obstruction
physical examination revealed a large polypoid mass obstructing the left nasal cavity
computed tomographic imaging showed soft tissue polypoid density
excluded_candidates: Inflammatory nasal polyps: reason ranked lower due to presence of EBV-positive and CD138-positive markers
Allergic rhinitis: reason ranked lower due to chronicity and presence of soft tissue mass
alarm_features: persistent nasal obstruction despite medical treatment
salient_findings: soft tissue polypoid density on CT
